source_checks.finding: Section 'How To Get Your Money Back: Gift Cards' says exactly: 'Contact the gift card issuer immediately. Use the number on the back of the card.' It also says 'Tell them that a scammer tricked you into giving them the card number and PIN.', 'Ask them to refund your money.', and 'Keep the gift card and the receipt, if you have it.' Applies to any device and to gift card payments, as the user describes.

Section 'How to Report a Romance Scam' says 'contact the company or your bank right away' and 'Tell them you paid a scammer and ask them to refund your money.' Applies to any device and to gift card payments. The same page, section 'How to Avoid Losing Money to a Romance Scammer', says 'Never send money or gifts to a sweetheart you haven't met in person.' That sentence supports the missing action below and should be cited for the fix.
Section 'If you suspect a romance scam' says 'Stop communicating with the person immediately.' and 'Talk to someone you trust.' Applies to any device and any online contact who asks for money.

Section 'How to Report a Romance Scam' says 'report it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov' and 'Notify the social networking site or app where you met the scammer, too.' Applies to any device and any romance scam.

required_actions.action: Stop communicating with the person now
Contact the gift card issuer immediately using the number on the back of the card
Tell the issuer that a scammer tricked you into giving the card number and PIN, and ask for a refund
Do not send him any more money or gift cards, since he is asking for more (user turn)
Keep the card and receipt if you have them
Report it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov
Notify the dating site or app where you met him
Talk with a trusted friend or family member

findings: The user says the man is 'now asking for more' and asks 'What do I do now?' The target never tells the user to stop sending him money or gift cards, so a critical protective action is missing.
Stopping contact does not by itself tell the user not to pay again, and no passage the model sees says it.
correction_required: Add a step, placed right after 'Stop communicating with him now.' or as step 1 before the issuer call, reading: 'Do not send him any more money or gift cards.' Source: FTC 'What To Know About Romance Scams', section 'How to Avoid Losing Money to a Romance Scammer': 'Never send money or gifts to a sweetheart you haven't met in person.' Keep the other steps unchanged and renumber the list.
